title: Kit creator
description: A custom made kit menu made in java for 1.21.11
body: This Kit Creator plugin lets you easily create and manage kits directly in-game. Using /kit, you open a simple kit editor where you can build and customize kits with items, armor, and more. With /kits, players can browse and access all available public kits. The system is designed to be quick, intuitive, and require no complicated setup, making it perfect for any server type. Server owners have full control over which kits are available and how they’re used. This is currently a beta release, so features may change and improve over time as the plugin continues to be developed and refined.
